text:
zoe: heads up — sudden uptick in wrong-context completions on /v1/stream at 02:12 UTC. multiple customers reporting fragments of other users' prompts. raising incident.

daniel: seeing it in metrics. p95 latency + error spikes. `kv_reuse_mismatch` alert firing. paging infra.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0782 created  assigned @nora (oncall)

nora: taking. quick look: recent PR merged to paged-kv enabled a chunk-reassign optim optimization and we also flipped continuous-batching reuse flag on for perf testing last night. likely interplay.

cs-rep: incoming customer reports from EdgeAI and FinCalc. EdgeAI says ~3% of requests in a 6m window included unrelated tokens. FinCalc noticed wrong numerical context in some streams.

daniel: sample log lines from worker-3:
```
2026-03-15T02:14:01Z worker-3 INFO kv_paged.cc:315 lookup key=model-5:seq=4096 -> chunk=18, offset=512
2026-03-15T02:14:01Z worker-3 WARN kv_paged.cc:327 reused_chunk metadata.seq=4050 request.seq=4096
2026-03-15T02:14:01Z worker-3 ERROR batcher.cc:210 applied_state_mismatch req=xyz123
```

zoe: that's bad. nora, can you flip the reuse flag off runtime-wide? and limit batch sizes to reduce overlap windows.

nora: starting runtime toggle: KV_REUSE_ENABLED=false on pool-edge (zone-1) now. will also set batch.max_tokens=512 -> 128 and batch.window_ms=25 -> 6.

deploy-bot: runtime change queued: KV_REUSE_ENABLED=false for pool-edge by nora at 02:18 UTC

cs-rep: notified EdgeAI & FinCalc that we're investigating and temporarily throttling to protect correctness.

daniel: after toggles, mismatch alerts fell sharply. p95 back near baseline after ~3m. still collecting bad-output samples for forensic analysis.

nora: immediate mitigation status: reuse off + reduced batching in all edge pools. recommending keeping reuse off until a patch.

zoe: can we patch quickly? suspected root cause: non-atomic snapshot of paged chunk header when chunk ownership changes during concurrent batch drains. fix: atomic clone of metadata + seq guard in reuse path.

daniel: agree. I can draft a small change in `runtime/kv/paged_reader.cpp` to take a ref-counted snapshot before returning cached pointer and add a check: if (cached.seq != req.seq) -> treat as miss. also add logging: `kv_reuse_reject` with request_id.

nora: open a cherrypick and run unit tests. if green, we can hotpatch canary.

deploy-bot: cherrypick PR #3401 opened by daniel -> CI started

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled nora -> zoe in 45m.

cs-rep: EdgeAI reported they ran a smoke test after mitigations: 0 failures in their subset. FinCalc still investigating; they saw improvement.

daniel: CI caught a race in staging tests initially; added a harness that simulates concurrent chunk reassign + high batch concurrency. tests now pass. ready to deploy to canary.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy to canary pool-edge at 02:49 UTC by daniel

nora: monitoring canary for 10m. key metrics: reuse_mismatch_count, kv_miss_rate, batch_latency_ms. also watching for perf regressions due to extra misses.

deploy-bot: canary stable at 03:01 UTC. no reuse_mismatch events in 12m.

zoe: start gradual rollout to remaining pools. keep KV_REUSE_ENABLED=false in the meantime until guard is in everywhere.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by nora at 02:20 UTC

cs-rep: EdgeAI confirms their full test suite passes now. FinCalc reports similar. marking customers as mitigated for now.

zoe: follow-ups:
- daniel: submit full PR to main + backport to stable branches
- nora: update oncall playbook with `reuse_mismatch` triage steps and a safety gate to prevent enabling reuse if `coalescing_window_ms > 30`
- zoe: customer RCA and SLA impact note
- ops: add Prometheus alert `kv_reuse_reject_rate > 5/min` to page SRE

nndaniel: also adding a long-term change: add an invariant test to our fuzzing harness to ensure no token interleaving across concurrent requests during paged-kv chunk moves.

nora: keeping reduced batch sizes for 2h as buffer. will hand to zoe at 03:03 UTC.

oncall-bot: Handoff nora -> zoe scheduled at 03:03 UTC

zoe: thanks all. timeline will be added to the incident ticket. closing bridge in 1h if no new mismatches.

-- end of thread --
